entries.name: SCERT_ResolvePktNode
entries.comment: Resolves or allocates a packet node from the connection recv ring. a0=connIndex, a1=reqType(<0x100), a2=outPktPtr. If nothing found returns 0xA. Used by SCERT_RecvPkt and SCERT_NewConn.

entries.name: SCERT_RecvDispatch_State1
entries.comment: Type dispatch state=1; jump table at 0x006639D0

entries.name: SCERT_RecvDispatch_State2
entries.comment: Type dispatch state=2; jump table at 0x00663A50

entries.name: SCERT_Handler_Type21_Error
entries.comment: OOO disconnect if type=0x21 received out of order

entries.name: SCERT_KeyCtxInstall
entries.comment: Installs key context into session; a0=session_ptr, a1=key_ctx. Called from SCERT_KeyExchange after RSA encrypt.

entries.name: SCERT_RSA_Encrypt
entries.comment: RSA encrypt call — a0=session_ctx, a1=plain_ptr(N_ps2). Called from SCERT_KeyExchange 0x636E70.

entries.name: FNC_memset
entries.comment: Likely memset or bclear; called with a2=0x40 to zero a 64-byte key buffer.

entries.name: gMUIS_ConnObjPtr
entries.comment: Global ptr to 0x3C-byte MUIS conn object

entries.name: DataReadyFlag
entries.comment: Polled via lbu; non-zero = server response parsed; stays 0 = hang

entries.name: TimeoutParam
entries.comment: Set from a2=6 at call site 0x003184A4

entries.name: SCERT_Overlay_Fn0
entries.comment: First fn at overlay base; calls 0x0034C6F0 0x003EFBD0 0x0034AD00 0x00180E10

entries.name: SCERT_BuildConnectTCP
entries.comment: STUB in r0004 static ELF; real overlay code confirmed in server dump 0x00634000-0x00664A4E

entries.name: SCERT_BuildType23Response
entries.comment: Stubbed in static ELF; real overlay code confirmed

entries.name: gSCERT_GlobalStruct
entries.comment: 8-byte ld + lh at +8; read by SCERT_Overlay_Fn1

entries.name: gN_server
entries.comment: Horizon RSA-512 N_server (64 bytes LE). PS2 uses this to RSA-encrypt CLIENT_CRYPTKEY_PUBLIC payload. Confirmed match with Horizon key via scan_pattern 2026-04-18.

entries.name: gSCERT_ContextPtr
entries.comment: Global SCERT session context pointer. Read by SCERT_AllocSendPkt at 0x636738 to find active session by IP.

entries.name: SCERT_RC4_DecryptLoop
entries.comment: PS2 RC4 decrypt loop — inner XOR at 0x63225C NOP'd to bypass RC4 decryption for testing. Loop branch at bne → 0x632200.

entries.name: SCERT_RC4_EncryptLoop
entries.comment: PS2 RC4 encrypt loop — inner XOR at 0x6322F8 NOP'd to bypass RC4 encryption for testing. Loop branch at bne → 0x6322A8.

entries.name: SCERT_RC4_DecryptXOR
entries.comment: RC4 decrypt XOR instruction. NOP'd (00000000) for testing. Original: 00C53026 (xor a2,a2,a1). Write 2063225C 00000000 to bypass.

entries.name: SCERT_RC4_EncryptXOR
entries.comment: RC4 encrypt XOR instruction. NOP'd (00000000) for testing. Original: 00832026 (xor a0,a0,v1). Write 206322F8 00000000 to bypass.

entries.name: SCERT_RC4_SetKey
entries.comment: PS2 RC4 key setup: reversed table init, hash-scramble pass (cipherIndex+=5), key schedule (cipherIndex+=3, keyIdx wraps at 64). Entered at 0x00632318 preamble area.

entries.name: SCERT_ConnectAcceptHandler
entries.comment: CRYPTKEY_PEER/CONNECT_ACCEPT handler. a1=incoming_len(0x49=73). Calls SCERT_ExpectedLenHelper(0x0063D6B0), validates length at bne s1,v1(0x0063D4DC), parses 3 bytes via 0x640668, writes response via 0x640A20/0x640AC8.

entries.name: SCERT_SocketValidator
entries.comment: Returns error if a0 is 0, -0x50, or -0x68 (invalid socket values). Called from SCERT_OuterRecvHandler.

entries.name: SCERT_WriteByteToPacketBuf
entries.comment: Writes a1 byte to a0 packet buffer ptr. Called at 0x0063D508, 0x0063D520, 0x0063D538.

entries.name: SCERT_ExpectedLenHelper
entries.comment: Returns (a0 & 0xFFFF) + 0x49 — computes expected receive length for CONNECT_ACCEPT. Called from 0x0063D4C8.

entries.name: SCERT_ReadSessionStateByte
entries.comment: Reads session state byte into sp+0x85 at 0x0063D57C. Returns nonzero on error → branch at 0x0063D584 to failure path.

entries.name: SCERT_ParsePacketBody3Bytes
entries.comment: Parses 3 bytes from packet body at offsets 0x82, 0x83, 0x84. Called at 0x0063D4F4.

entries.name: SCERT_WriteUInt16ToPacketBuf
entries.comment: Writes uint16 into packet buffer. Called at 0x0063D550.

entries.name: SCERT_SendConnectCompleteResp
entries.comment: Sends CONNECT_COMPLETE response. Called at 0x0063D56C from SCERT_ConnectAcceptHandler. Failure here → SCERT_ErrorDisconnect path.
